newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold eases slightly in higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold eases slightly in higher volume.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange rose to 1,378 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's 844 kilos on continued physical demand, dealers said.
Gold closed slightly easier at $349.00 an ounce and 1,539,000 lira per gram, versus $349.80 and 1,544,500 lira in line with lower levels in European markets.
"There is a slow, but steady increase in physical demand on the exchange, some of today's volume was also due to registration by banks," one dealer said.
Banks must register newly imported gold on the exchange by selling and rebuying it before they can sell to non-members outside the bourse.
The Turkish currency firmed to 136,950 to the dollar compared to 137,390 lira on Wednesday.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,263 kilos -- took place in the morning session and 69.5 percent of the total was traded in lira terms.
